verifications.claim: Good Friday is not a federal holiday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Good Friday is not a federal holiday" (R3, R4, R5, R6); "While not a federal holiday" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources directly state Good Friday is not a federal holiday.

verifications.claim: Most banks in the U.S. remain open on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "For most banks, it’s business as usual" (R2); "most banks will operate normally" (R3); "most banks will be open" (R4, R5, R6, R7)
verifications.reasoning: All listed sources directly confirm most U.S. banks remain open.

verifications.claim: The NYSE is closed on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "New York Stock Exchange, will be closed" (R3, R4, R5, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state NYSE is closed on Good Friday.

verifications.claim: The Nasdaq is closed on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Nasdaq... will be closed" (R3, R4, R5, R7)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources explicitly state Nasdaq is closed on Good Friday.

verifications.claim: The Federal Reserve remains open on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "Good Friday is not a Federal Reserve holiday... Federal Reserve stays open" (R3); "according to The Federal Reserve" (R5, implying open)
verifications.reasoning: R3 directly states Federal Reserve stays open; R5 supports via reference to Fed schedule.

verifications.claim: Most commercial banks operate with regular business hours on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "business as usual" (R2); "operate normally" (R3); "regular business hours" (R4, R7); "Most banks will be open" (R5, R6)
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm most banks (including commercial) open with regular or normal hours.

verifications.claim: Most credit unions operate with regular business hours on Good Friday.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: "A handful of smaller community banks or credit unions may choose to close"
verifications.reasoning: Only R3 mentions credit unions, implying most open (handful close), but does not specify regular hours.

verifications.claim: USPS operates normally on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "USPS operates as usual... open during regular business hours" (R3); "open, and mail will be delivered" (R5, R7); "open and operating as usual" (R6)
verifications.reasoning: Multiple sources confirm USPS operates normally with regular hours and deliveries.

verifications.claim: UPS operates normally on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "UPS and FedEx are also operating" (R3); "UPS... open and... available" (R5); "open and operating as usual" (R6); "continue deliveries" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Sources consistently state UPS operates normally or as usual.

verifications.claim: FedEx operates normally on Good Friday.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: "UPS and FedEx are also operating" (R3); "operate as normal" (R5); "open and operating as usual" (R6); "continue deliveries" (R7)
verifications.reasoning: Most sources confirm normal operations; R5 notes modified for some services but normal for others.
